 Medium
 Large
 Print Image via Rockstar Games ​ GTA 6 pre-loading begins November 10 on PS5 and Xbox. Rockstar Games says the download will require up to 212 GB, depending on the device, giving players a reason to check their available console storage before the game’s November 19 launch. The pre-load lets players download the game ahead of release, though access begins only at launch. ​ The starting time differs between platforms. PlayStation 5 downloads will open at midnight in each player’s local time zone, while Xbox Series X|S downloads will begin simultaneously worldwide at midnight GMT. Players planning to download the game in advance will need sufficient storage and time to complete the transfer before launch. ​ How much storage will GTA 6 need
 ​ Rockstar says the pre-load file will require up to 212 GB “depending on your device.” Its announcement does not provide separate download sizes for PS5, Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S. ​ Sony has asked PS5 players to free up at least 212 GB before pre-downloading. Players whose consoles are already close to capacity should review installed games and other stored content before November 10. ​ Rockstar has asked players to “make sure you’ve got ample space to begin pre-loading as soon as possible.” ​ When does pre-loading begin in India
 ​ PS5 players in India can begin downloading GTA 6 at 12 am IST on November 10, following the platform’s local-midnight schedule. For Xbox Series X|S, the global start time of 12 am GMT on November 10 translates to 5:30 am IST that day. ​ Both platforms therefore begin pre-loading nine days before release. Downloading early gives players time to complete the transfer, particularly on slower internet connections. ​ How players need to prepare before launch
 ​ PlayStation’s guidance asks players to confirm that their account details and sign-in information are current, pre-order the game and clear the required storage. Rockstar directs players to its support site for platform-specific pre-load instructions. ​ Code-in-box versions for both consoles are expected to reach retailers from November 12. These include a download code, so buyers should allow time to download the game before release. ​ Rockstar plans free poster and map downloads
 ​ On November 19, Rockstar will add a printable GTA 6 cover-art poster and a map of Leonida to its official website for free download. A double-sided physical poster will follow shortly after launch through the Rockstar Store. It will cost $0.99 separately or be included as a free gift with any store purchase.
